versions.title: Smarter suggestions, a clipboard that stays put, and smoother typing
items: The right word, first try. Suggestions have been rebuilt from the ground up, so the word you mean lands on top far more often — including everyday Egyptian words like fahem (فاهم), nazel (نازل), and salamat (سلامات).
Your clipboard is safe. Pasting from Franconvert no longer wipes out what you had copied before. It's put back right after the paste.
Pastes land where you expect. Franconvert now waits until the app you were typing in is ready, so a paste doesn't go missing when switching takes a moment.
Fast typing just works. Hitting Space, Enter, or Tab right after you type now always uses the word you actually typed, never an older one.
Easier on the eyes. Clearer text sizes, better contrast in light mode, and accent colours that keep text readable whichever colour you pick.

Little things that add up. Esc closes Settings, scrollable areas fade at the edge when there's more to see, the letter picker no longer covers your suggestions, and Franconvert checks for updates every few hours while it's running.
Friendlier for screen readers and keyboards. Suggestions, buttons, and switches are announced properly, and everything in Settings can be used from the keyboard.

versions.title: A roomier widget, clearer text, and one app instance
items: More room to type. The default widget is now 600 × 440, keeping the same proportions with a minimum text size of 11pt throughout the app.
A lighter interface. Separators are more subtle, shortcut keys are borderless with extra padding, and theme previews keep a 16:9 ratio.
Stable starter-word hints. Paste and Tab hints appear beside the words without moving entries when you hover.
Reliable Mac shortcuts. Settings shows the correct Command-based default and retains the Command key when recording a custom shortcut.
One instance at a time. Opening another copy brings the running widget forward without clearing your text. Quit older builds once when switching to this version.

versions.title: More reliable suggestions, dependable letter swaps, and clearer overlays
items: Logical spellings resolve more naturally. Common forms such as hatha, hadha, and haza now correctly rank هذا first, with stronger handling for ambiguous digraphs and final vowels.
Multi-letter swaps now stick. Selecting two or more Latin letters and replacing the span with one Arabic letter is validated as a single choice instead of silently ignoring part of the replacement.
Picker choices stay locked while typing. Combined-letter overrides and tashkeel survive subsequent edits as long as their Latin span still matches.
Floating tips are readable. Letter pickers, shortcut hints, and toast chips now use a stronger frosted surface so labels underneath no longer show through.
Better regression coverage. The engine now checks every declared picker alternative and a golden set of common logical spellings automatically.

versions.title: Smarter suggestions, full-word tashkeel, and a friendlier UI (release candidate before v1.0)
items: Way smarter suggestions. A big dictionary upgrade means common words like tab3an (طبعاً), 7abibi (حبيبي), and insha2allah (إن شاء الله) land on top from the very first try, even when you spell them in shorthand.

One-tap tashkeel for a whole word. Press Ctrl+T (or ⌘+T on Mac) with your cursor at the end of a word to add all the diacritics in one go. Select a single letter and only that letter gets the marks — same shortcut, smarter behavior.
Edit any word by clicking it. Click a committed word in the preview to re-open it for editing. No more backspacing through everything to fix one word.
Starter words on the empty screen. The empty-widget view shows your go-to phrases. ↵ pastes, Tab drops the phrase into the input so you can keep typing.
Numbers convert to Arabic-Indic. Type 2026 → ٢٠٢٦. Press Tab on the suggestion to keep the English form. Single bare digits (3, 7) still mean ع / ح.
Two-letter swap. Select two adjacent letters in the input, then Ctrl+G (or ⌘+G) to pick alternates for both at once.
Per-letter tashkeel picker. Ctrl+T on a selected letter shows every diacritic option — fatha, kasra, damma, sukun, shadda combos, tanween.
Shortcut hints when you need them. Highlight any letter and a small hint appears showing the swap and tashkeel shortcuts. Dismiss it once and it won't come back.
All shortcuts in one place. Settings now has a Shortcuts page listing every keyboard shortcut, with the right key icons for Windows and Mac.
Reset to a fresh start. A new Reset app button under Settings → System wipes everything Franconvert has learned about you, so you can start over or hand the app to someone else.
Cleaner picker. Removed some redundant labels in the letter and tashkeel pickers so you can focus on the choices.

versions.title: Letter picker — swap a single Arabic letter without retyping
items: Press <kbd>Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>G</kbd> (or <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>G</kbd>) on a suggestion to open a letter picker.
Pick a different Arabic letter for any ambiguous Latin consonant (z → ز/ظ/ذ, t → ت/ط/ث, etc.).
Use <kbd>Tab</kbd> to cycle between letter positions, arrows to choose, <kbd>Enter</kbd> to apply.
Your choice is locked to the suggestion and survives further edits to the rest of the word.
Confirmed picks are remembered, so next time the right spelling shows up first.
